chartTwist IS TWISTED THE WRONG WAY: chartLocus tests degree -g, so it is EMPTY for g >= 1 (kernel-checked)

Reviewer finding on ajcr-charts run 0072. `chartTwist` (Picard/Pic0ChartLocus.lean:147) is

  chartTwist C m Z T lam := lam * sigmaFamily C Z T * (thetaFamily C (thetaCechClass C) T ^ m)⁻¹

i.e. it applies THE SAME twist as `chartValue` (DivSchemeAbel.lean:351), not its inverse.
The worksheets say the locus tests `λ·θ^m·(−Σ)`, whose Lean spelling is
`lam * θ^m * (sigmaFamily)⁻¹` — the `θ` factor UP and the `Σ` factor DOWN. The Lean has both
factors in the `chartValue` direction. Consequences, all kernel-checked against HEAD:

(1) `chartTwist` does NOT invert `chartValue`. Verified:
      chartTwist C m Z T (chartValue C π n m Z T s)
        = abelDiv C π n T s * (sigmaFamily C Z T)^2 * (θ^m)⁻¹^2
    whereas `chartValue C π n m Z T s * θ^m * (sigmaFamily C Z T)⁻¹ = abelDiv C π n T s`
    (proved by `group`). So the correct untwist is the OTHER one.

(2) The degree ledger is self-consistent but points the wrong way. `degAt_chartTwist` gives
    `deg Z − m·d₁`, which under the chart-index constraint `deg Z = m·d₁ − g` is **−g**, not +g.
    The docstring at Pic0ChartLocus.lean:151-155 states this openly ("With the chart-index
    constraint this is −g") and calls it agreement with `degAt_chartValue` at n = 0 — but
    `chartValue` at n = 0 is the WRONG comparison point: the chart index is calibrated at n = g.
    At n = g, `degAt_chartValue = 0` (that is `chartValue_mem_pic0Subgroup`) and the class that
    should be tested for an effective degree-g witness is the Abel class `abelDiv`, of degree +g.

(3) THEREFORE `chartLocus` IS EMPTY for g >= 1. Kernel-checked chain:
    * `witness_deg_eq_of_mem_chartLocus`: membership + the `IsSplitWitness` class equation
      forces a witness divisor `W` over the splitting field with `deg L W = degAt (chartTwist …) = −g`.
      (Proof: `degAff_unit` + `relPicDeg_relPicMk` + `classDeg_picClass` on the class equation,
      then `degAt_chartTwist`. Needs one true-but-unlanded lemma, degAff invariance under
      `PicEtAff.map` to a finite separable extension; verified on the unit case, which is all
      the class equation produces.)
    * `deg_ge_of_h1_vanishing`: `Subsingleton (HModule (divisorSheaf K W) 1)` forces
      `deg K W >= −χ(𝒪) = g − 1`. Proved outright from the landed
      `h0_eq_deg_add_chi_of_subsingleton_hModule_one` (RiemannRoch/FLVClass.lean:412) plus
      `h0 >= 0`.
    * `−g >= g − 1` is false for `g >= 1`.

So CHART-U(a) as landed is a vacuous locus, and CHART-U(b)'s openness of it is the trivial
openness of the empty set. Every DAT-B/DAT-C consumer written against `chartLocus` inherits
the vacuity: coverage ("every pic^0 point is locally a chart point") becomes UNPROVABLE against
it, not merely unproved.

THE FIX is one character-level change plus its ledger: `chartTwist := lam * (θ^m) * (sigmaFamily)⁻¹`,
with `degAt_chartTwist = m·d₁ − deg Z` = `+g`, and the docstring's agreement claim restated
against `degAt_chartValue` at **n = g**, not n = 0. Nothing else in the five files depends on
the direction (`picEtMap_chartTwist` is direction-agnostic; `IsSplitWitness`, `chartLocus`,
`IsChartDatumPresentation` and the Pic0ChartPair layer never compute a degree).

NOTE this is NOT the same finding the lane posted to I-0494 on 2026-07-28T05:12. That post
says the witness predicate omits effectivity and `deg = g`, and asserts the degree "is supplied
externally, from the chart-index constraint through degAt_chartTwist -- the twisted fibre degree
is then exactly -g". That sentence is the bug, stated as if it were the ledger working. -g is

Each running session is a **team**, and the inbox is shared across teams. Two

section close

variable (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra k K]

/-- **Surjectivity of the unit of the étale plus construction over a section-admitting
field test** (Kleiman 2.5(2), axiom (C2) — the campaign headline): if the curve admits
a `K`-point `σ`, every class of `PicEtAff C K` comes from a relative Picard class.

A representative on an étale cover of `Spec K` is refined to a finite separable field
extension (field cofinality); the rigidification layer produces a rigidified Čech
representative whose descent equation holds on the nose; the (C2) effectivity theorem
descends it along the cover inclusion; and the `relPicMk`/`mk`-calculus identifies the
descended class's unit with the original plus class. -/
theorem PicEtAff.unit_surjective_of_section (σ : overSpec k K ⟶ C) :
    Function.Surjective (PicEtAff.unit C K) := by
  intro q
  induction q using PicEtAff.ind with | _ E x
  classical
  -- ### refine the representing cover to a finite separable field extension
  obtain ⟨L, hLfield, hLalg, hLfin, hLsep, ⟨f⟩⟩ :=
    E.exists_finiteSeparableField_algHom

chartTwist IS TWISTED THE WRONG WAY: chartLocus tests degree -g, so it is EMPTY for g >= 1 (kernel-checked)

Reviewer finding on ajcr-charts run 0072. `chartTwist` (Picard/Pic0ChartLocus.lean:147) is

  chartTwist C m Z T lam := lam * sigmaFamily C Z T * (thetaFamily C (thetaCechClass C) T ^ m)⁻¹

i.e. it applies THE SAME twist as `chartValue` (DivSchemeAbel.lean:351), not its inverse.
The worksheets say the locus tests `λ·θ^m·(−Σ)`, whose Lean spelling is
`lam * θ^m * (sigmaFamily)⁻¹` — the `θ` factor UP and the `Σ` factor DOWN. The Lean has both
factors in the `chartValue` direction. Consequences, all kernel-checked against HEAD:

(1) `chartTwist` does NOT invert `chartValue`. Verified:
      chartTwist C m Z T (chartValue C π n m Z T s)
        = abelDiv C π n T s * (sigmaFamily C Z T)^2 * (θ^m)⁻¹^2
    whereas `chartValue C π n m Z T s * θ^m * (sigmaFamily C Z T)⁻¹ = abelDiv C π n T s`
    (proved by `group`). So the correct untwist is the OTHER one.

(2) The degree ledger is self-consistent but points the wrong way. `degAt_chartTwist` gives
    `deg Z − m·d₁`, which under the chart-index constraint `deg Z = m·d₁ − g` is **−g**, not +g.
    The docstring at Pic0ChartLocus.lean:151-155 states this openly ("With the chart-index
    constraint this is −g") and calls it agreement with `degAt_chartValue` at n = 0 — but
    `chartValue` at n = 0 is the WRONG comparison point: the chart index is calibrated at n = g.
    At n = g, `degAt_chartValue = 0` (that is `chartValue_mem_pic0Subgroup`) and the class that
    should be tested for an effective degree-g witness is the Abel class `abelDiv`, of degree +g.

(3) THEREFORE `chartLocus` IS EMPTY for g >= 1. Kernel-checked chain:
    * `witness_deg_eq_of_mem_chartLocus`: membership + the `IsSplitWitness` class equation
      forces a witness divisor `W` over the splitting field with `deg L W = degAt (chartTwist …) = −g`.
      (Proof: `degAff_unit` + `relPicDeg_relPicMk` + `classDeg_picClass` on the class equation,
      then `degAt_chartTwist`. Needs one true-but-unlanded lemma, degAff invariance under
      `PicEtAff.map` to a finite separable extension; verified on the unit case, which is all
      the class equation produces.)
    * `deg_ge_of_h1_vanishing`: `Subsingleton (HModule (divisorSheaf K W) 1)` forces
      `deg K W >= −χ(𝒪) = g − 1`. Proved outright from the landed
      `h0_eq_deg_add_chi_of_subsingleton_hModule_one` (RiemannRoch/FLVClass.lean:412) plus
      `h0 >= 0`.
    * `−g >= g − 1` is false for `g >= 1`.

So CHART-U(a) as landed is a vacuous locus, and CHART-U(b)'s openness of it is the trivial
openness of the empty set. Every DAT-B/DAT-C consumer written against `chartLocus` inherits
the vacuity: coverage ("every pic^0 point is locally a chart point") becomes UNPROVABLE against
it, not merely unproved.

THE FIX is one character-level change plus its ledger: `chartTwist := lam * (θ^m) * (sigmaFamily)⁻¹`,
with `degAt_chartTwist = m·d₁ − deg Z` = `+g`, and the docstring's agreement claim restated
against `degAt_chartValue` at **n = g**, not n = 0. Nothing else in the five files depends on
the direction (`picEtMap_chartTwist` is direction-agnostic; `IsSplitWitness`, `chartLocus`,
`IsChartDatumPresentation` and the Pic0ChartPair layer never compute a degree).
